lines.text: People is sitting... at a cafe.
lines.style: Speak English as a Japanese beginner who learned it from textbooks: katakana-like vowels added after consonants, flat syllable-by-syllable timing, every syllable equally stressed. Keep it natural, not a caricature. Keep a brisk pace: one short pause at the dots only, the whole line in about two seconds.

lines.text: The hanging lamp lights the counter where people are gathered.
lines.style: Speak fluent General American English. Use native vowel and consonant sounds, accurate word stress, smooth linking and natural sentence intonation. Reduced unstressed syllables, stress-timed rhythm, rhotic r, flapped t. Say "counter" clearly (COWN-ter).
